    CHAPTER I

“Give... us some pudding,” the child said, holding out his plate.

“Give.. us some pudding,” he said again, rather more loudly now.

“Give ..... us some pudding,” he repeated for the third time here.

A line may not properly end with a trailing ellipsis like this ...
.The line above ended badly and this one begins with a full stop.

“But the cars. ... they had gone by then,” the old woman told him.

A properly spaced ellipsis ... is not reported by this check here.

... A line beginning with three dots and a space is also allowed.

The sentence trailed away into nothing at all and stopped....
